story.text: A way to understand interactions of people concerned with the collaborative work of making interactions meaningful: People are not standing in space, they "queue". They do not chain words together they "ask questions" to "understand". This is not given, though it seems to be just there: Meaning needs to be made.
[[External Cognition]] could be strongly linked, but most Ethnomethodologists seem to be more concerned with words rather than materials (but Studies of work and/or Sudnow might be pointers there)
[[Process]] as meaning are not fixed but need to be made and shaped.
[[Dorothy Smith]] combines ideas from ethnomethodology with feminists ideas.
